values.binNote: Wiki says the collision bonus scales with primary target's bonus health; the bin field is named PercentHPCarryThrough with no explicit stat qualifier, and the base collision damage uses the same LeeSinR#Damage calculation as the primary hit. Mapped targetMaxHp as an approximation of 'bonus health' since the checker's stat list has no bonusHp-of-target term for this context (used targetMaxHp with binNote flagging the wiki explicitly says 'bonus health', not max health).

mechanics.claim: Lee Sin roots the target over the cast time, then kicks them, dealing damage and knocking them back, rendering them airborne for 1 second.
mechanics.quote: roots the target enemy champion over the cast time, then roundhouse kicks them to deal {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} {{tt|up to 800 units|see notes}} {{tt|over {{fd|0.8}} seconds|Estimated}}, rendering them {{tip|airborne}} for 1 second

mechanics.claim: Enemies that collide with the airborne displaced target take the same damage plus a bonus based on the primary target's bonus health, and are also knocked up.
mechanics.quote: Enemies that collide with the displaced enemy while it is {{tip|airborne}} take the same damage plus {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and are {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for 1 second

mechanics.claim: If the ability kills the primary target, it still knocks the corpse back, which can collide with and damage other enemies.
mechanics.quote: If ''Dragon's Rage'' kills the primary target, it will still knock them back, causing the target's corpse to be displaced and collide with enemies it passes through.

mechanics.claim: The ability can be blocked by spell shields.
